`resolveImageInput` treats any array as raw bytes, so `image: ["data:image/png;base64,..."]` (the shape the codex/nanobanana adapters accept for multi-reference) becomes `Uint8Array.from(["data:..."])` which is `Uint8Array [0]`. That has length 1, passes this check, and Cloudflare gets a 1-byte `input_image_0`, so the caller gets an unconditioned or failed generation instead of the 400 the tests promise for unsupported input.

I'd only take the byte-array branch when every element is an integer 0-255, and otherwise either map string entries to `input_image_0..3` (FLUX.2 accepts up to 4 per the linked changelog) or throw `Invalid reference image`. `body.images` is also ignored here, which is the same silent drop this PR is fixing. A test with `image: [DATA_URL]` would cover it.

Real gap, good catch. The intercept lived only in nonStreamingHandler, so a forced-streaming provider would hide the search call inside the SSE and hand the client back an unanswered tool call. Fixed in a4e8066: handleForcedSSEToJson now receives the fallback plan via sharedCtx and applies applyWebSearchFallback at all three client-format return sites (Responses-native passthrough, chat/gemini-built body, and the chat-SSE converted body). The call is internally guarded, so requests with no plan pass straight through. One nuance: a Claude-format client never reaches this path with a claude-shape body (the translator converts before dispatch), so extractHandledCalls seeing only openai/claude shapes is fine here. Regression test added at tests/unit/forced-sse-websearch-intercept.test.js covering chat and Responses clients on both SSE sources.

Fixed in b0851058: a failed `response.done` enters the error path before computing a Chat finish reason. The emitted chunk carries a top-level error, with a fallback error when upstream omits one. Added a regression for this terminal event.

`saveModels` ignores the POST response. If the user deselects the last model and closes the modal, this endpoint returns 400 because `models` is empty, but local state still shows no models while the previous `models.yml` contents remain persisted. Check `res.ok`; on failure, surface the error and rehydrate via `checkStatus()` (or make deselect-all a supported persistence path).
